mechanism: MAOIs combined with ACE inhibitors increase risk of severe hypertension, hypertensive crisis, and serotonergic effects due to combined sympathomimetic potentiation and altered norepinephrine metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; allow minimum 14 days washout after tranylcypromine discontinuation before initiating benazepril, or use alternative antidepressant with lower MAOI interaction potential.
